units.text: With script files (e.g. ⟦0⟧,⟦1⟧,⟦2⟧ files) the license notice typically appears ⟦3⟧after⟦4⟧ the first line (the ’shebang’ ‘⟦5⟧’ line). The ⟦6⟧ command will add ⟦7⟧ ⟦8⟧after⟦9⟧ the first line:
units.sourceHTML: With script files (e.g. .sh,.py,.pl files) the license notice typically appears after the first line (the ’shebang’ ‘#!’ line). The 1rFILE command will add FILE after the first line:
